sourceDocuments.title: Biochemical Transformations in Garri and Fufu Processing
sourceDocuments.text: Cassava root post-harvest processing requires efficient cyanogenic glucoside detoxification. Solid-state fermentation of grated mash for seventy-two hours enables endogenous linamarase hydrolysis of linamarin and lotaustralin into acetone cyanohydrin, which volatilizes during subsequent dehydration.

studentDocument.title: Cyanogenesis and Processing Safety of Manihot esculenta
studentDocument.text: Cassava root post-harvest processing requires highly efficient cyanogenic glucoside detoxification. Solid-state natural fermentation of grated cassava mash for seventy-two hours enables endogenous linamarase enzyme hydrolysis of linamarin into acetone cyanohydrin, which volatilizes during subsequent dehydration roasting.
